info.title: Subject Advisors UC20 Forecast Planning API
info.description: PLANNED contract only. These endpoints are not implemented. Decided 2026-11-02 (MT8): data provision has two sources. The main source snapshots the current students in the system (student_profile / academic_record, read-only; student-entered records count as COMPLETE history, students without records are UNKNOWN); a CSV upload is the other source. Decided 2026-11-02 (MT9): the Coordinator chooses the data source PER FORECAST on the Imports screen (students in the system, CSV import, or Both); it is not an admin setting. Both builds ONE combined snapshot (system students plus the CSV students not already in the system, system record wins on a matric match; see createCombinedSnapshot). Each forecast is based on one snapshot. This replaces the earlier rule that UC20 never queries student profiles. CSV people remain external-reference cohorts and are never linked to portal students. Product owner rules 2026-11-01 (S2-P004-006): finalizing a forecast publishes nothing; the Coordinator then CONFIRMS offerings per programme + learning centre + target semester and sets a pick DEADLINE through the Offering confirmation operations below; students see only those confirmed subjects and may pick until the deadline. The target semester is the NEXT semester after the system current semester managed by the System Administrator (Academic Semesters module, planned marker). Coordinators are ASSIGNED (admin-managed, planned) to faculty, programme and learning centre and act only within their assignments (403 SCOPE_NOT_ASSIGNED). The Coordinator sees, side by side with the forecast, the pick count AND the list of students who picked each subject (name, matric number, current semester, credits completed; ordering by seniority as a display aid) for the programme and centre in their assignment only; this reverses the earlier counts-only rule. Students never see other students' picks, and the data is never an input to the forecast calculation. The cycle ends when students have picked and the Coordinator sees the counts and pickers and decides (no automatic allocation): no class-section creation from picks, no registration, no timetable. Class sizes: LAB maximum 35, LECTURE (non-lab) maximum 45, optimal 25. Planned migrations target the development database (Neon development branch) only.

tags.name: Imports
tags.description: Single-file cohort upload and immutable accepted snapshots.

tags.name: Forecasts
tags.description: Initial advisory baseline, decisions and audit. A forecast (including FINALIZED) is advisory and publishes nothing; it helps the Coordinator decide which subjects to make available next semester.

tags.name: Configuration
tags.description: Forecast configuration for System Administrators only.

tags.name: Offering confirmation
tags.description: PLANNED. Coordinator confirmation of the subjects offered for a programme + learning centre + target (next) semester, and read-only student pick counts with the list of pickers per subject (assigned coordinators only). Confirmation is deliberate, audited, and is what students see as 'Confirmed by coordinator'.

get.summary: Read configured programme, centre, semester and curriculum options
get.description: Requires an active Coordinator. Returns configured programmes, centres and semesters. With programmeId, also returns that programme's configured curriculum versions, curriculum_subject -> subject catalogue, exclusions and prerequisite expressions/conditions. This endpoint never calls student/profile/options APIs. Scopes are read live from the administrator's academic setup on every request (S2-P004-011, no caching): only the caller's unended coordinator assignments with active programme, faculty and learning centre are returned; a coordinator without assignments gets empty programmes, learningCentres and assignedScopes. When no semester is marked current, currentSemesterId and targetSemesterId are null and targetSemesters is empty; scoped mutations then return 409 TARGET_SEMESTER_UNAVAILABLE.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: native (default) returns the standard template header; coordinator returns the coordinator export header plus two synthetic example rows (S2-P004-010).

get.summary: List import summaries in a required scope
get.description: Programme, centre and target semester filters are required. The list is paginated and returns metadata/counts, not raw CSV rows. Import list rows are summaries; use import detail to retrieve the full validation report and warnings.

post.summary: Validate one CSV and accept it when all rows are valid
post.description: Fully valid uploads are accepted directly, including warnings. Row errors return a 422 correction report without accepting rejected history. Valid roster metadata is retained when a subject-history row is invalid. The file is bound to programme, centre and target semester; the server verifies all IDs against configured catalogue rows. The caller actor is derived from the verified active Coordinator session. After current authorization, replay lookup returns the original receipt before mutable resource state or ETag/revision checks; same key with a different payload conflicts. CSV v1 accepts optional UTF-8 BOM, comma/double-quote escaping and LF/CRLF; trims fields, treats trimmed-empty as blank, compares opaque external references case-sensitively (1-128 Unicode characters), allows int32 positive semester IDs and nonnegative integer credits, and limits uploads to 5 MiB/10,000 data rows (20,000 raw rows for the coordinator export format). Coordinator export format (S2-P004-010, decided 2026-11-02): a header with courseCode, subjCode, centerName, stuname, stuMetricNo and grade (case-insensitive, any order; SemesterMohon and status optional; eMail and other columns are ignored and never stored) is detected automatically and normalised into the standard model before validation (external_reference = stuMetricNo, student_name = stuname, curriculum_version blank, cohort ACTIVE, history COMPLETE). Rows of other programmes (exact programme_code or a configured alias), other learning centres (configured aliases), inactive students (status belongs to the student: any N row skips ALL rows of that student in the file, including exemption rows with a blank status; a status other than A, N or blank counts as active with a COORDINATOR_STATUS_UNKNOWN warning) and in-progress rows (blank or NULL grade) are skipped and counted, subjects outside the curriculum are skipped with a COORDINATOR_SUBJECTS_SKIPPED warning, grades A+ to D+ complete, EX and PENGECUALIAN exempt, every other non-blank grade fails, and only the latest SemesterMohon attempt per student and subject is kept. The report carries format and coordinatorExport counts. A successful accepted-import response includes the complete validation report, including nonblocking warnings; warnings remain retrievable from import detail. No raw CSV is returned. MT3 implementation notes: multipart/form-data (file + scope fields) or a raw text/csv body with the same fields in the query string; the target semester must be the one after the current semester; the optional student_name column is stored; the earlier nine-column header is still accepted. Idempotency-Key is validated (1-128 characters) but not persisted; instead, the same file bytes (sha256 source fingerprint) for the same scope that are already accepted replay the original snapshot with 200. A 422 correction report whose rows are partly valid is stored as a VALIDATED batch awaiting subset acknowledgement; a file rejection or a report with no usable students is stored as REJECTED.

post.summary: Snapshot the students in the system (main data source)
post.description: Decided 2026-11-02: the Coordinator can build the forecast from the CURRENT STUDENTS IN THE SYSTEM instead of uploading a CSV (the Coordinator chooses the source per forecast; see also the CSV and combined snapshot operations). The server stores one ACCEPTED, immutable snapshot of the students whose curriculum belongs to the programme, whose learning centre equals the requested centre (resolved through the scope provider; interim: every student counts under KL until profiles record a centre) and whose access is ACTIVE with the STUDENT role. Student-entered academic records count as COMPLETE history (source: student-entered); a student with no academic record is UNKNOWN history. COMPLETED, EXEMPTED and FAILED map as-is; WITHDRAWN is stored as FAILED; records whose subject is not in the student's curriculum are skipped and counted. External reference is PORTAL-<student_id>. The response is the accepted import with source SYSTEM and a coverage report. The same fingerprint in the same scope replays the existing snapshot with 200; changed data creates a new snapshot (201). student_profile and academic_record are never written. Target semester must be the one after the current semester. 422 SYSTEM_SNAPSHOT_EMPTY when no student matches.

422.description: The target semester is not allowed, or SYSTEM_SNAPSHOT_EMPTY.

get.summary: Read import provenance and quality summary
get.description: Returns the scoped accepted import and complete validation quality report, including nonblocking warnings; never returns raw CSV.

post.summary: Accept remaining valid rows after explicit acknowledgement
post.description: Only available for a validation with row errors and valid rows remaining. If-Match binds acknowledgement to the validation report/fingerprint revision; the validation may be accepted once. This is the uploading Coordinator's acknowledgement, not a second-person policy approval. After authentication, an idempotent replay resolves to the original receipt before current validation state is checked. After current authorization, replay lookup returns the original receipt before mutable resource state or ETag/revision checks; same key with a different payload conflicts. MT3 implementation notes: only the uploading Coordinator may acknowledge (anyone else gets 404); If-Match must be the quoted validation revision and match the body; a retry after success replays the receipt; Idempotency-Key is not persisted.

get.summary: List runs in a required programme/centre/semester scope

post.description: Requires an ACCEPTED import snapshot matching all three scope IDs and an assigned Coordinator. Runs the deterministic UC20 engine and, in one transaction, stores the DRAFT run (next version number in the programme + centre + semester namespace; parent = the previous version), subject demand rows and proposed sections, together with the rule snapshot, engine version, original recommendations and per-subject near-graduation/breakdown/reason counts. Supported eligible-pool demand is advisory, not registration. Missing evidence creates per-student/subject uncertainty; missing capacity creates CONFIGURATION_REQUIRED for the affected subject only. Idempotency (MT5a): an import snapshot yields exactly one forecast, so a repeat for the same importBatchId returns the existing run receipt with 200; Idempotency-Key is validated (1-128 characters) but not persisted. A newer accepted snapshot of the same scope creates version N+1 (UC23 owns comparison); the older run then reports newerForecastAvailable. Deviates from the planned "version 1 only" rule so a corrected re-import can be forecast.

get.summary: Read a run and its saved assumptions
get.description: Subjects with demand, uncertain counts and reasons, nearGraduationCount, configuration status, sections and recomputed flags, the run revision (body and ETag), the newerForecastAvailable indicator and the newest audit entries. Unassigned scopes are indistinguishable from absent runs (404).

get.summary: Read the students behind one subject of a run (view only)
get.description: Read-only roster for judging a subject. The forecast stores only per-subject counts, so the list is recomputed by the same engine functions from the run's frozen import snapshot and stored target semester; its tallies equal the stored breakdown and nearGraduationCount unless catalogueMatchesRun is false. Never changes demand and has no per-student overrides. Same authorization and scope handling as the run detail: unassigned scopes and absent runs are 404 RUN_NOT_FOUND; a subject that is not part of the run is 404 RUN_SUBJECT_NOT_FOUND. No query parameters.

post.summary: Review or adjust sections and append audit entries
post.description: Request carries all three scope IDs; server verifies them against the stored run. Requires If-Match and Idempotency-Key. Actor, before/after values and timestamp are server-derived. Changes and append-only audits commit atomically. An idempotent replay returns the original receipt after authentication, before the current revision is checked. Idempotency keys are server-namespaced by actor, operation and programme/centre/semester; key text need not embed scope. After auth, replay lookup precedes mutable state/revision checks. After current authorization, replay lookup returns the original receipt before mutable resource state or ETag/revision checks; same key with a different payload conflicts. MT5a: decisions are allowed in DRAFT and UNDER_REVIEW, are validated against the current run and applied all-or-nothing (a transaction guard re-checks the revision under a row lock). Errors: 409 RUN_FINALIZED, 412 RUN_REVISION_MISMATCH, 422 DECISION_REASON_REQUIRED, DECISION_DUPLICATE_SUBJECT, DECISION_SUBJECT_NOT_FOUND, DECISION_NO_SECTIONS, SUBJECT_NOT_CONFIGURED, ALLOCATION_INVALID, ALLOCATION_TOTAL_MISMATCH, ALLOCATION_EXCEEDS_CAPACITY.

Request carries all scope IDs and they must match the stored run. Requires If-Match and Idempotency-Key. Validate required reviews, append the final audit, and freeze in one transaction. Finalization is advisory and does not itself publish or confirm any offering; the Coordinator confirms offerings as a separate, later step (see Offering confirmation operations). Idempotency keys are server-namespaced by actor, operation and programme/centre/semester; key text need not embed scope. After auth, replay lookup precedes mutable state/revision checks. After current authorization, replay lookup returns the original receipt before mutable resource state or ETag/revision checks; same key with a different payload conflicts. Finalization is allowed only from UNDER_REVIEW after required reviews; successful finalization records non-null actor/time and freezes the run. MT5a: every proposed section must be REVIEWED, APPROVED or DEFERRED (422 REVIEWS_INCOMPLETE with details.pendingSubjectIds); 409 RUN_STATE_CONFLICT unless UNDER_REVIEW, 409 RUN_FINALIZED when already frozen. reason is optional (default "Forecast finalized.").

get.summary: Read a bounded page of append-only decisions
get.description: Append-only decision history, newest first, cursor-paged. Entries carry subjectId (null for FINALIZE) and full before/after section states; proposedSectionId is always null because an entry covers all sections of a subject.
Active System Administrator only. This role does not gain access to cohort imports or forecasts.

put.summary: Update capacity, exclusion and stale-source configuration
put.description: Active System Administrator only. Requires If-Match and Idempotency-Key. The API never seeds provisional capacity numbers. The new version appends configuration and never mutates rows referenced by existing runs. After current authorization, replay lookup returns the original receipt before mutable resource state or ETag/revision checks; same key with a different payload conflicts.

post.summary: Move an initial draft into review
post.description: Explicit DRAFT to UNDER_REVIEW transition. Scope must match the stored run. Requires If-Match and Idempotency-Key. Replay lookup follows authentication and precedes current state/revision checks. Idempotency keys are server-namespaced by actor, operation and programme/centre/semester; key text need not embed scope. After auth, replay lookup precedes mutable state/revision checks. After current authorization, replay lookup returns the original receipt before mutable resource state or ETag/revision checks; same key with a different payload conflicts. Errors: 400 IF_MATCH_REQUIRED, 404 RUN_NOT_FOUND, 409 RUN_STATE_CONFLICT (not DRAFT) or RUN_FINALIZED, 412 RUN_REVISION_MISMATCH. Idempotency-Key is validated but not persisted; a retry after success sees a stale revision (412). The transition writes a run-level START_REVIEW audit entry (subjectId null, actor, reason defaulting to "Review started.", before {status: DRAFT}, after {status: UNDER_REVIEW}) in the same transaction; the database allows it only from DRAFT and once per run. It increments the revision audit count (DRAFT revision fr<id>.DRAFT.0 becomes fr<id>.UNDER_REVIEW.1).

get.summary: PLANNED: read the confirmed offerings for a programme + centre + target semester
get.description: Active Coordinator only. Returns the latest confirmation state per subject (CONFIRMED and WITHDRAWN) and the set revision (also as ETag). The latest confirmation for the scope is authoritative and is what students see. The target semester is the next semester for the students served. Private, no-store. Coordinator scope: the authenticated Coordinator must be assigned (admin-managed, planned) to the programme and learning centre; otherwise 403 SCOPE_NOT_ASSIGNED.

post.description: Active Coordinator only. A deliberate action, never automatic. Requires a FINALIZED forecast run for the same programme + centre + target semester (recorded as provenance); excluded subjects (Projek Sarjana Muda 1/2, Latihan Industri, UKQT3001 and other non-classroom subjects) cannot be confirmed (422 SUBJECT_EXCLUDED); a subject that does not run in the forecast's semester type under the Normal/Short offering rule cannot be confirmed (422 SUBJECT_NOT_OFFERED_IN_SEMESTER_TYPE, details.subjectIds); a WITHDRAWN subject may be re-confirmed. A non-blank reason is required and a pick deadline (pickDeadline, future date-time; send the current one on re-confirmation) is part of the confirmation: students can pick and change picks only until it, after which picks are closed (read-only). Actor and time are derived server-side and appended to the audit atomically with the state change. The request carries baseRevision (null when no confirmation exists); a stale revision returns 412. Idempotency-Key replays return the original receipt. Students then see these subjects as 'Confirmed by coordinator'; this is not official registration and not a guaranteed timetable. Forecasts and pick counts are not changed by this operation. A new forecast run/version never changes, invalidates or requires re-confirmation of existing confirmations (decided); the confirmation only keeps forecastRunId as provenance. Coordinator scope: the authenticated Coordinator must be assigned (admin-managed, planned) to the programme and learning centre; otherwise 403 SCOPE_NOT_ASSIGNED.

Active Coordinator only. Marks the listed subjects WITHDRAWN for the scope with a required reason, audited atomically. Withdrawn subjects disappear from the student list; existing student picks for them are kept but excluded from the student's list and from pick counts (OP7). Requires baseRevision (stale returns 412) and Idempotency-Key. Coordinator scope: the authenticated Coordinator must be assigned (admin-managed, planned) to the programme and learning centre; otherwise 403 SCOPE_NOT_ASSIGNED.

get.summary: PLANNED: audit of confirm and withdraw actions in a scope
get.description: Active Coordinator only. Append-only entries with actor, time, reason and before/after status. Bounded by limit/cursor. Coordinator scope: the authenticated Coordinator must be assigned (admin-managed, planned) to the programme and learning centre; otherwise 403 SCOPE_NOT_ASSIGNED.

get.summary: PLANNED: student pick counts and pickers per subject for a scope
get.description: Active assigned Coordinator only. Per subject, the COUNT of student picks and the LIST of students who picked it, for programme + learning centre + target (next) semester, shown side by side with the forecast. Decided 2026-11-01: coordinators manage the students of their assigned centre and need to see who picked (this replaces importing names and untaken subjects from the student management system), so that senior students can be prioritised to graduate sooner. Only students whose profile programme + learning centre fall within the coordinator's assignment are returned; otherwise 403 SCOPE_NOT_ASSIGNED. No small-number suppression. Pickers carry studentId (profile ID, never a Clerk ID), studentName, matricNo, currentSemester, creditsCompleted and the planned intakeSemester. The default order is by seniority (decided 2026-11-01: credits completed toward the curriculum, highest first; tie-break the earliest intake, then the current semester); this is a display aid, the coordinator decides and nothing is allocated automatically. Students never see other students' picks. Display only: not an input to the forecast calculation. Each entry also carries classType and implied classes (ceil(picks / maximum), LAB 35 / LECTURE 45) against optimal 25 as a display aid. The cycle ends here: no class sections from picks, no registration, no timetable. Private, no-store; personal data must not be cached in shared caches or logged. Coordinator scope: the authenticated Coordinator must be assigned to the programme and learning centre. The seniority ordering is display-aid policy version 1, revisable by a new change record and an update to the single shared helper; no migration because ordering is computed, never stored.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Order of pickers within each subject; display aid.

post.summary: PLANNED: change the pick deadline for a scope
post.description: Active assigned Coordinator. Sets the date-time after which students can no longer pick or change picks for the programme + learning centre + target semester (replaces the Google Form practice). A future date-time and a reason are required; actor and time are derived server-side and the change is audited (action SET_DEADLINE) atomically. Requires baseRevision (stale returns 412) and Idempotency-Key. Coordinator scope: the authenticated Coordinator must be assigned (admin-managed, planned) to the programme and learning centre; otherwise 403 SCOPE_NOT_ASSIGNED.

get.summary: List the retained roster of an accepted import
get.description: Active assigned Coordinator. Returns the retained students (external reference, optional name, curriculum version, cohort status, final history completeness), keyset-paged by importedStudentId. Unassigned, unknown and non-accepted imports return 404. Never returns attempts or raw CSV.

post.summary: Snapshot the students in the system plus a CSV (data source: Both)
post.description: Decided 2026-11-02: the Coordinator chooses the data source per forecast (students in the system, CSV import, or both). "Both" builds ONE snapshot, therefore one forecast, made of the system students (same selection and mapping as the system snapshot) PLUS the students of the uploaded CSV who are not already in the system. Duplicates: the SYSTEM record wins and the CSV student is skipped when the CSV external_reference equals the system student's matric_no (trimmed, case-insensitive, only when matric_no is non-empty and unique among the selected system students) or the system PORTAL-<id> reference. A CSV student whose student_name equals a system student name (normalised) but whose reference differs is included and reported as a POSSIBLE_DUPLICATE_STUDENT warning; records are never merged on name. Matric numbers are used in memory only and are never stored. The CSV part is validated exactly like POST /forecast-imports. Rows to correct give 422 IMPORT_CORRECTION_REQUIRED with an ETag; the valid part (system students plus the valid CSV students) is stored as a VALIDATED batch and accepted with the existing POST /forecast-imports/{validationId}/subset-acceptances (If-Match). A valid CSV gives 201 with an ACCEPTED batch whose source is COMBINED. The fingerprint covers the CSV bytes and the system data; the same inputs in the same scope replay the existing snapshot with 200. History: system students COMPLETE (with records) or UNKNOWN (none); CSV students as given. validation_summary.internal keeps a per-student source map; GET .../students returns source per student. Generate run, review, finalize and confirm are unchanged.

ETag.description: Opaque current revision used with If-Match.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Server namespaces by authenticated actor, operation and programme/centre/semester scope. MT5a: validated (1-128 characters) but not persisted (no receipt table); retries are covered by the same-snapshot replay for generation and by revision checks for mutations.

details.description: Optional safe identifiers for the failure, e.g. pendingSubjectIds for REVIEWS_INCOMPLETE. Never SQL or provider text.

row.description: Record number in the file; the header is record 1. Null for findings that span rows.

classType.description: May be null when the canonical subject class_type is absent.

assignedScopes.description: Programme x centre pairs the Coordinator is assigned to.

currentSemesterId.description: System current semester; null when none is marked.

targetSemesterId.description: The only semester an import may target: the one after the current semester (targetSemesters holds it); null when unavailable.

file.description: UTF-8 CSV with optional BOM, comma delimiting, doubled-quote escaping, LF or CRLF. Trim surrounding spaces; trimmed-empty is blank. At most 5 MiB and 10,000 data rows (20,000 for the coordinator export). Header: the template header including the optional student_name column, the earlier nine-column header, or the coordinators' own export header (courseCode, subjCode, centerName, stuname, stuMetricNo, eMail, SemesterMohon, grade, status), detected automatically.

external_reference.description: Opaque case-sensitive source reference, 1 to 100 Unicode characters (the stored column is varchar(100)); never a portal identity.

curriculum_version.description: Blank only with exactly one configured programme curriculum version.

cohort_status.description: ACTIVE has a provisional engineering mapping to supported potential demand. Unrecognized tokens are per-student uncertainty.

subject_code.description: Blank only when the five-field attempt group is empty.

subject_status.description: Blank only when all five attempt fields are blank. WITHDRAWN is not normalized.

record_semester_id.description: Positive decimal int32 lexeme; implementations must reject numeric values above 2147483647.

recognized_credits.description: Nonnegative decimal integer no greater than verified catalogue credit hours. FAILED and IN_PROGRESS accept blank or 0 only; positive recognized credit on either is invalid.

is_synthetic.description: Blank only for a no-history row.

student_name.description: OPTIONAL display name so the Coordinator can tell managed students apart (product owner decision 2026-11-01). Blank allowed; identical on every row of a student; no control characters. Never a portal ID or credential. The earlier nine-column header without this column is still accepted.

coverage.description: Present on system-students and COMBINED snapshots (the system part).

forecastCount.description: Null is unknown; never encode as zero.

ForecastRun.description: Checked constraint: status FINALIZED requires non-null finalizedBy/finalizedAt; DRAFT and UNDER_REVIEW require both null. Finalized runs are immutable.
ForecastRun.x-superseded-by: ForecastRunDetail (MT5a, S2-P004-007): runs are versioned per programme + centre + semester and carry the engine rule snapshot.

oneOf.description: subjectId is the canonical subject.subject_id, not curriculum_subject_id. REVIEW, APPROVE and DEFER set every current section of the subject to REVIEWED, APPROVED or DEFERRED; REOPEN sets them back to PENDING (clearing the reviewer), for example to add back a removed subject; a subject without sections cannot be decided. A reason of 1-500 characters is required for every decision.

replacementSections.description: Full replacement allocation for the subject. Omitted existing section IDs retire those sections from the current allocation; historical section/audit rows are retained.

oneOf.description: subjectId is the canonical subject.subject_id, not curriculum_subject_id. The replacement must keep section numbers 1..n, may change the number and sizes of sections, but the sizes must add up to the subject forecastCount (a replacement redistributes demand, it never creates or removes it). Each size is 1..exceptionMaximum (or normalMaximum when none is configured); a size above normalMaximum is an exception and stores its justification (falling back to the decision reason). Subjects that are EXCLUDED or CONFIGURATION_REQUIRED cannot be replaced. Retired sections are removed from the editable allocation; their details stay in the audit before-state and in originalRecommendations.

actionType.description: REVIEW, APPROVE, DEFER, REPLACE_ALLOCATION, REOPEN, START_REVIEW (run-level, subjectId null) or FINALIZE (run-level, subjectId null).

effectiveToSemesterId.description: Null means no end semester; otherwise a positive canonical int32 ID.

CapacityRule.description: Decided 2026-11-01: two class types, LAB (normalMaximum 35) and LECTURE/non-lab (normalMaximum 45); optimal class size 25 is the breakEvenTarget. Entered as configuration, not seeded. Earlier example values 40 / 30 / 35 are withdrawn.

effectiveToSemesterId.description: Null means no end semester; otherwise a positive canonical int32 ID.

SubjectExclusion.description: subjectId is a positive canonical int32 ID from the subject catalogue. Effective semester IDs are positive canonical int32 IDs from the shared configured semester catalogue. Effective ranges use configured academic-year/term chronology, never numeric ID order; a non-null end must not precede its start.

staleSourceMaxAgeDays.description: Null means no configured threshold; emit a warning.

ForecastConfigurationRequest.description: Create a new immutable configuration version/active pointer; never mutate capacity rows referenced by a forecast.

CurriculumRequirementSnapshot.description: Mirrors curriculum_requirement; required_subjects is a nullable nonnegative count, not an ID list.

forecastRunId.description: FINALIZED run the confirmation was based on (provenance).

revision.description: Null before the first confirmation for the scope.

pickDeadline.description: Deadline after which student picks are closed; null before the first confirmation.

forecastRunId.description: Source FINALIZED run (provenance); null before the first confirmation.

pickWindow.description: Derived from pickDeadline and the server clock.

pickDeadline.description: Pick deadline. Students may pick or change picks only until this time.

pickers.description: Length equals pickCount. Seniority order by default.

pickDeadline.description: Picks are closed (read-only) after this time.

picksAvailable.description: False until student picks exist (P002): counts are zero and pickers empty.

OfferingPickCountSummary.description: Pick counts and the list of pickers per subject, for an assigned Coordinator only. Display only; not an input to the forecast calculation; no automatic allocation.

forecastRunId.description: Optional: switch the source run to another FINALIZED run of the same scope.

ImpliedClasses.description: Display aid only; not a class-section proposal and not a forecast input.

averageSizeAtMaximum.description: picks / classesAtMaximum, to compare with the optimal size 25.

OfferingPicker.description: A student who picked the subject, shown to an assigned Coordinator only.

studentId.description: student_profile.student_id; never a Clerk user ID.

intakeSemester.description: PLANNED field (P001); no intake is stored today, null until recorded.

creditsCompleted.description: Sum of recognized credits of COMPLETED/EXEMPTED academic records toward the curriculum; null when unavailable.

NewerForecastAvailable.description: OP1, informational only: a later version exists for the same programme + centre + semester.

excludedSubjects.description: Subjects excluded in the catalogue (include_in_offering_forecast = false). Does not include notOfferedInSemesterTypeSubjects.

notOfferedInSemesterTypeSubjects.description: Subjects that do not run in the run's semester type (Normal/Short offering rule from subject_semester_rule). No demand, no sections, not counted in totals.

pendingSubjects.description: Subjects with at least one PENDING section; finalization needs this to be 0.

subjectsBelowMinimum.description: Subjects whose potential demand is under the minimum enrolment.

revision.description: Optimistic-concurrency token (also the quoted ETag). Changes on every lifecycle step and decision.

flags.description: Recomputed on every read from the stored capacity rule values.

semesterTypeExcluded.description: Normal/Short offering rule: every curriculum containing the subject has subject_semester_rule rows for it and none is the run's semester type. Stored as configurationStatus EXCLUDED with forecastCount null; no demand, no sections, not in totals; cannot be confirmed (422 SUBJECT_NOT_OFFERED_IN_SEMESTER_TYPE). A subject with no rule rows is unrestricted. Never true together with excluded.

semesterTypeExclusionReason.description: "Runs only in Short semesters" or "Runs only in Normal semesters"; null unless semesterTypeExcluded.

supportedEligibleCount.description: Potential demand: the supported eligible pool.

forecastCount.description: Null for excluded subjects; never zero for unknown.

nearGraduationCount.description: Information only; never part of the demand count.

breakdown.description: inCurriculum, alreadyPassed, notOfferedInSemesterType, prerequisiteNotMet, supported, uncertain, retakeResolvedAsPassed.

ForecastRunDetail.description: A forecast run with its subjects, sections, saved rule snapshot and newest audit entries. The same revision is returned as the ETag.

revision.description: Optimistic-concurrency token (also the quoted ETag). Changes on every lifecycle step and decision.

ruleSnapshot.description: Engine rule/capacity snapshot (EngineRuleSnapshot in packages/shared); immutable.

originalRecommendations.description: The engine output per subject, kept beside every later adjustment.

audit.description: Newest first, at most 100; page all entries from /audit.

dataSource.description: Source of the import snapshot the forecast is based on. SYSTEM means student-entered portal records; COMBINED means student-entered records plus a CSV import (Combined: student-entered records + CSV import).

ImportSource.description: Where the snapshot came from: an uploaded CSV, the students in the system (portal snapshot, MT8), or both in one COMBINED snapshot (MT9). The Coordinator chooses per forecast. Snapshots written before MT8 read as CSV.

SystemSnapshotCoverage.description: Coverage of a system-students snapshot. Student-entered academic records count as COMPLETE history; students with no academic record at all are UNKNOWN history and so uncertain.

recordsUnmapped.description: Skipped: the subject is not part of the student's curriculum.

withdrawnStoredAsFailed.description: WITHDRAWN is not a passed status; it is stored as FAILED.

centreNote.description: Documents the interim centre rule: until student profiles record a learning centre every student counts under KL.

StudentSource.description: Where one retained student came from. In a COMBINED snapshot the system record always wins over a CSV record of the same student.

CombinedSnapshotCoverage.description: Coverage of a COMBINED snapshot. The system part is the report coverage (SystemSnapshotCoverage).

students.description: Students in the snapshot: system students plus the CSV students not already in the system.

csvSkippedAlreadyInSystem.description: CSV references skipped because the external_reference equals the matric number (trimmed, case-insensitive, non-empty and unique among the selected system students) or the PORTAL reference of a system student. The system record is used.

possibleDuplicates.description: CSV students whose student_name equals a system student name (normalised: trimmed, whitespace collapsed, case-folded) but whose reference differs. Both are included; never merged on name.

ImportFileFormat.description: Detected from the CSV header row. Absent on standard-template reports (read as NATIVE).

CoordinatorExportSummary.description: Counts only (no personal data) of what the coordinator-export reader did with the file. Skipped rows are not errors.

rowsRead.description: Data rows read from the file.

skippedOtherProgramme.description: courseCode does not map to the selected programme (exact programme_code or a configured alias such as SECJH to SECJ).

skippedOtherCentre.description: centerName does not map to the selected learning centre (configured aliases such as KUALA LUMPUR to KL, or the centre code).

skippedInactive.description: Rows of inactive students: a student with any status N row is inactive and all their rows are skipped (including blank-status exemption rows). Blank or A is active.

skippedInProgress.description: Rows with a blank or NULL grade (current short semester); not used yet.

olderAttemptsDropped.description: Older attempts (and repeated exemptions) replaced by the latest attempt per student and subject.

skippedSubjectNotInCurriculum.description: Rows skipped because the subject code is unknown or not in the programme curriculum. Reported by the COORDINATOR_SUBJECTS_SKIPPED warning.

unknownStatusRows.description: Rows with a status other than A, N or blank; treated as active.

outcome.description: SUPPORTED students are the counted potential demand.

uncertaintyReasons.description: Sorted; empty unless outcome is UNCERTAIN.

nearGraduation.description: True only for SUPPORTED students counted in nearGraduationCount.

remainingCredits.description: Curriculum credits still to earn; null when the curriculum total or a passed credit value is unknown.

passedByRetake.description: PASSED only: a pass plus another attempt, resolved as passed.

matricNo.description: Matric number of a portal student (reference PORTAL-<student_id>), read live from the student profile for display only and never stored. Null for CSV students (their externalReference is the matric number) and for portal students who have not added one.

email.description: Sign-in (primary) email of a portal student (reference PORTAL-<student_id>), read live from the identity provider for display only and never stored. Null for CSV students, unknown accounts, or when emails could not be loaded.

catalogueMatchesRun.description: False when the live curriculum catalogue no longer matches the run's stored rule snapshot; the list was then recomputed with the current curriculum and may differ from the stored counts.

notCounted.description: Already passed + prerequisite not met + not offered this semester.

breakdown.description: inCurriculum, alreadyPassed, notOfferedInSemesterType, prerequisiteNotMet, supported, uncertain, retakeResolvedAsPassed.

emailsAvailable.description: False when sign-in emails could not be read from the identity provider; matric numbers are still shown, and portal students without one show their reference.

ImportAcceptedResponse.description: Accepted immutable import or its summary; no-store.

ImportValidationResponse.description: 422 correction report. No invalid history is accepted. No-store; ETag binds a later subset acknowledgement.

ForecastRunResponse.description: Forecast run detail (subjects, sections, saved assumptions, newest audit); no-store; ETag identifies its revision.

ForecastRunListResponse.description: Bounded page of run summaries, newest first; no-store.

ForecastOperationResponse.description: Operation receipt. Replays return the original receipt, not the current mutable resource.

Forbidden.description: Active identity lacks the required verified role.

ScopeNotFound.description: Resource or configured scope unavailable; mismatched IDs are not disclosed.

Conflict.description: Idempotency mismatch, existing initial run or lifecycle conflict.

InvalidDecision.description: Decision/configuration is invalid for current state or rules.

Unavailable.description: Retryable dependency failure; SQL/provider details are not exposed.

ConfirmedOfferingSetResponse.description: Latest confirmation state per subject for the scope; no-store.

OfferingPickCountResponse.description: Pick counts and pickers per subject (assigned coordinator only); contains personal data; no-store.

ImportStudentListResponse.description: Bounded page of the retained roster, including optional student names; no-store.

RunSubjectStudentsResponse.description: Students behind one subject of a run; no-store.
